speaker: Unknown
en: I could feel the pressure of competition coming in.
zh: 我能感觉到竞争的压力正在袭来。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was the competition at the time?
zh: 当时的竞争是什么样的？

speaker: Unknown
en: So at the point that I wanted to do commercials, we had just, so that was in 2015.
zh: 所以在我想做电视广告的那个节点，我们刚刚——那是 2015 年。

speaker: Unknown
en: In January 2015 at CES, there was at least 30 people that launched, call it competitive product to Ring.
zh: 2015 年 1 月的 CES 上，至少有 30 个人发布了，可以说是与 Ring 竞争的产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: So they were like at zero?
zh: 所以他们当时是零？

speaker: Unknown
en: They were at zero.
zh: 他们是零。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had launched, remember, we had launched, so we had kind of door-bought, we had all this stuff, but we had only launched Ring October of 2014.
zh: 我们已经发布了，记得吗，我们已经发布了，我们做过众筹（door-bought），我们有这些东西，但我们 2014 年 10 月才发布 Ring。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we had luckily...
zh: 所以我们很幸运……

speaker: Unknown
en: From the press or whatever, we kind of had like established ourselves as this, but we were not like established.
zh: 从媒体或其他什么渠道来看，我们有点建立了自己的名声，但我们并不是真的站稳了脚跟。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, we weren't, you know, we weren't doing crazy sales.
zh: 我是说，我们没有，你知道，我们没有做疯狂的销售额。

speaker: Unknown
en: Were you doing a million a month yet in revenue?
zh: 你们当时月收入到一百万了吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: No, we were probably going into five hundred, six hundred thousand a month or something.
zh: 没有，我们当时大概是往每月五十万、六十万美元那个方向。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we were like, maybe like a...
zh: 所以我们大概像是……

speaker: Unknown
en: But like in consumer electronics, like doing less than, doing a hundred million a year in consumer electronics would be a small, you know, so like, so like we were, the market I'd say was still very open in 15.
zh: 但在消费电子领域，一年做到不到一亿的话就算小了，你知道，所以我们当时，我要说市场在 15 年还是非常开放的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So like if I would have had a company and I'm like, fuck, I'm gonna spend 10 million on TV ads, like I could have probably crushed you.
zh: 所以比如如果我有一家公司，我说，操，我要花一千万投电视广告，那我很可能就能把你压垮。

speaker: Unknown
en: So your thinking was,
zh: 所以你的想法是，

speaker: Unknown
en: I just need to get out there.
zh: 我只需要冲出去。

speaker: Unknown
en: Someone's going to take it.
zh: 总会有人把它抢走的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would say our office was in Santa Monica.
zh: 我想说我们的办公室在圣莫尼卡。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I said, in Santa Monica, if we go out of business, I want the hole to be so deep that it can never be filled.
zh: 我说过，在圣莫尼卡，如果我们倒闭，我希望这个坑深到永远无法被填上。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of these VC-backed companies will over 20 years go out of business.
zh: 很多这些 VC 支持的公司在 20 年里会倒闭。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they just squeak out of business.
zh: 而它们只是勉强地倒闭。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to be a massive explosion if we were going to go out of business.
zh: 我想要的是，如果我们要倒闭，就来一场巨大的爆炸。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to blow a hole in the ground.
zh: 我想在地上炸出一个洞。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm like, we have like basically a million dollars left.
zh: 所以我想，我们基本上还剩大概一百万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're selling, so like, we're not like, we're not just ripping through cash.
zh: 我们在卖产品，所以，我们并不是，我们并不是在纯粹地烧钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we're selling some products.
zh: 所以我们还在卖一些产品。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm like, if it's like a million dollars, I'm like, I want to jump to the next level.
zh: 所以我想，如果还剩一百万美元，我想，我想跳到下一个层级。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, I think we should, and a friend, this company, GoodRx, had just launched.
zh: 然后我想，我们应该——一个朋友，这家公司 GoodRx，刚刚起步。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was at soccer with my son, and the son of one of the founders of GoodRx is there.
zh: 那是在我儿子踢足球的时候，GoodRx 一位创始人的儿子也在那里。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're talking, and again, we're both super small companies, like this is not, you know.
zh: 我们聊天，再说一遍，我们都是超级小的公司，你知道，不是什么大人物。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's telling me, oh yeah, we just went on doing TV, and like, this is the results we're having.
zh: 他告诉我，哦对，我们刚开始投电视，然后，这是我们拿到的结果。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's like, unbelievable.
zh: 而且简直，难以置信。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, so I tell my wife, I'm like, like at the end of the soccer game, like I'm going to the office,
zh: 于是我告诉我妻子，我说，就在足球赛结束的时候，我说我要去办公室，

speaker: Unknown
en: We're going to do TV.
zh: 我们要做电视广告。

speaker: Unknown
en: And she's just like, I don't know what you're talking about.
zh: 而她就是，我不知道你在说什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, I'll see you later.
zh: 我就说，回头见。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that was like a Saturday.
zh: 那大概是个周六。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I came home like, you know, like I didn't like come home.
zh: 就像我回家了，你知道吗，其实我并没有回家。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, I'm like figuring out how to do TV.
zh: 我就像是在琢磨怎么做电视广告。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I go to the board and I'm like, I want to basically spend, you know, we're going to blow a million dollars on TV.
zh: 于是我去找董事会，我说，我基本上想花，你知道的，我们要在电视上砸一百万美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: So why are TV ads so good?
zh: 那为什么电视广告这么好用？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because a lot of tech people would say they're unmeasurable and like, you know, just you don't know where the money's going.
zh: 因为很多科技圈的人会说电视广告没法衡量，你知道吗，就是钱花到哪去了你都不知道。

speaker: Unknown
en: So why was it such a good idea?
zh: 那为什么这是个这么好的主意？

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, I mean, I could see what GoodRx was doing.
zh: 嗯，我是说，我能看到 GoodRx 在做什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to do, I did feel also that like to this competition thing and seeing what, you know, one of the companies that I tried to sort of mimic was Dyson.
zh: 我想做，我也确实感觉到，回到那个竞争的话题，看到，你知道的，我试图去模仿的公司之一是 Dyson。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you look at how James Dyson, again, go back to like Dyson, Dyson, James Dyson, how he did his ads and the authenticity.
zh: 如果你看看 James Dyson，又回到 Dyson、Dyson、James Dyson，他是怎么做广告的，以及那种真实性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you go back to when he started Dyson, he's no longer on the ads.
zh: 你回到他创立 Dyson 的时候，他已经不再出现在广告里了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so people don't see it.
zh: 所以人们看不到那段历史。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for a long time, it was like James Dyson was like on our TV being like, you know, I spent, you know, 300 years trying to build this, you know, thing.
zh: 但有很长一段时间，就像 James Dyson 出现在我们的电视上，说什么，你知道的，我花了三百年想造出这个东西。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, we need to be the James Dyson, the Dyson of home security in our own sort of voice.
zh: 我就说，我们需要成为 James Dyson，用我们自己的风格做家居安全领域的 Dyson。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I felt like TV was the way to do it.
zh: 所以我觉得电视就是实现这个的方式。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm seeing this company having success with it.
zh: 我看到这家公司用它取得了成功。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, we should just drop the hammer and let's get this.
zh: 我就说，我们应该直接下重手，就这么干。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we had a board meeting and, you know, there's definitely a bunch, like the board overall, I'd say it was like, if you think that's good, let's do it.
zh: 我们开了一次董事会，你知道，确实有一堆，总体上董事会，我想说大概是，如果你觉得这个好，那就干吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was one person who was like,
zh: 有一个人是这样的，

speaker: Unknown
en: Like that's your insane, you know, your size, you can't do, like you can't do TV.
zh: 就是说你疯了，你知道，你的规模，你不能做，你不能做电视广告。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like this goes to your Silicon Valley question of like, which I always think Silicon Valley is funny.
zh: 这就回到你那个硅谷的问题，我一直觉得硅谷很好笑。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like it's a place that like, you're supposed to be like the most creative, yet they have so many rules.
zh: 它是一个你本应该最有创造力的地方，然而他们有那么多规矩。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it's like, oh, you can't do TV until you're a hundred million.
zh: 你知道，就像，哦，你做不到一亿之前不能做电视广告。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said, so you're doing a hundred million in sales, you can't do TV.
zh: 他说，所以你做到一亿销售额，你不能做电视广告。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I was like, I can do whatever I want.
zh: 而我说，我想干什么就干什么。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so, so we, but we did TV and it is actually very hard and it is hard to measure.
zh: 于是，我们就做了电视广告，而且它确实非常难，也很难衡量。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's also, it usually is like a rubber band where like you pull and pull and pull and pull and pull and nothing happens.
zh: 而且它通常就像一根橡皮筋，你拉啊拉啊拉啊拉啊拉，什么都没发生。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're like, oh my God, this isn't working.
zh: 你就想，天哪，这不管用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then all of a sudden the back sort of shoots, shoots forward.
zh: 然后突然之间，后面就弹，弹上去了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it did for like the first couple of weeks is like sales were basically the same.
zh: 所以前几周基本上是这样，销售额基本没变。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're like, uh-oh, like this isn't good.
zh: 你就想，糟了，这可不好。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had this like Google tracker, like this Google sheet that we were doing.
zh: 我们有这么一个 Google 跟踪表，就是那个我们在用的 Google sheet。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're like tracking the sales and like putting it in and putting how much we spent every day.
zh: 我们在跟踪销售额，把它填进去，把每天花了多少钱也填进去。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it's like, oh, this is like, and then all of a sudden,
zh: 然后就觉得，哦，这个，然后突然之间，

speaker: Unknown
en: Like the sales start just like, now you can see them climbing.
zh: 销售额开始，现在你能看到它在往上爬了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you think it was the TV ads?
zh: 你觉得那是电视广告的效果？

speaker: Unknown
en: At that point, that was all we were doing.
zh: 在那个时候，那就是我们全部在做的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, we were doing some, I mean, like a little other, but like you could definitely, you could see it like materially doing it.
zh: 我是说，我们也在做一些，我是说，一点别的，但你绝对能看到它，你能看到它明显地在起作用。

speaker: Unknown
en: You could see like the brand awareness coming up.
zh: 你能看到品牌知名度在上升。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like you started to see it all start to come up.
zh: 你开始看到一切开始往上走。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then of course, instead of me being like, okay, let's just stay at that spend.
zh: 然后当然，我没有说，好吧，我们就保持那个投放额度。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, okay, double the TV spend, triple the TV spend.
zh: 我是说，好，电视投放翻倍，电视投放三倍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we went from like, yeah, like 500,000 a month or whatever in January to like a million a month.
zh: 然后我们从，对，就像一月份的每月五十万美元左右涨到了每月一百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: We started raising our B round in like call it like end of spring, early summer of 15.
zh: 我们开始在大概 15 年春末夏初的时候启动 B 轮融资。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll never get this.
zh: 这个我永远忘不了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Richard Branson was one of the big investors in that.
zh: Richard Branson 是那轮的大投资人之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: When I talked to Richard in June, we were doing about a million a month.
zh: 我六月和 Richard 谈的时候，我们做到大约每月一百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was a million a month and growing.
zh: 是每月一百万而且还在增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: And our projection was to be like, we're going to try to get to like 20 million, like basically 2 million a month by like the end of the year.
zh: 我们的预测是，我们要努力做到，到年底基本上达到每月两百万左右，就像两千万。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we ended up, by the time we closed the round in the end of July, it was the end of July, early August, we had already doubled.
zh: 而到最后,等到我们七月末完成这一轮融资时,是七月末八月初,我们已经翻倍了。

speaker: Unknown
en: We went from a million to two million a month by that time.
zh: 到那时,我们从每月一百万涨到了每月两百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: So like during the round closing, we doubled our, like our revenue was going so fast at that point that we couldn't even track it ourselves.
zh: 所以就在融资完成期间,我们翻倍了,当时我们的收入增长太快了,连我们自己都跟不上追踪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like we were, like our projections were off.
zh: 就是我们,就是我们的预测都偏了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it was wild.
zh: 所以那太疯狂了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously that round was like, people were like, okay, I'm glad I invested.
zh: 显然那轮融资,人们都说,好吧,我很高兴我投了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Cause like, I mean, we basically priced it off of
zh: 因为,我的意思是,我们基本上是根据

speaker: Unknown
en: Numbers that were just like, I mean, it's very rare you close around and the company's like, surprise, like we're doing twice as big as we thought we were, like, you know, like they're like, no way.
zh: 那些数字来定价的,我的意思是,很少有你完成一轮融资,然后公司说,惊喜,我们的规模是你们以为的两倍,你知道,他们都说,不会吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, a lot of times what you see is they time the fundraise at the optimal time to price.
zh: 我的意思是,很多时候你会看到人们把融资时间安排在定价的最优时点。

speaker: Unknown
en: And we just were like, we actually just, just it was like out of control.
zh: 而我们就是,我们其实就是,简直失控了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, the bad part was like the costs were out of control a little bit too, because we were just like, when you're, again, you're growing that fast, like customer service, like
zh: 我的意思是,坏的一面是成本也有点失控了,因为你,再说一次,当你增长那么快的时候,比如客服,

speaker: Unknown
en: You're just hiring people.
zh: 你就只是在不停招人。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're just trying to get ahead of these like systems because systems are breaking daily, like a $10 million run rate company, a $20 million run rate company are like almost two different companies.
zh: 你只是想在这些系统面前跑在前面,因为系统每天都在崩,一家一千万美元 run rate 的公司和一家两千万美元 run rate 的公司几乎是两家不同的公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then we went from there to like 3 million a month, 4 million a month.
zh: 然后我们从那里涨到了每月三百万、每月四百万。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I mean, so it just, it just kept, it just kept like compounding.
zh: 我的意思是,就是,它一直在,一直在像复利一样滚动增长。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's the hardest part to get right?
zh: 最难做对的部分是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Or what was like the biggest thing that would break at that point?
zh: 或者说在那个阶段最容易崩的最大问题是什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: I think the hardest part is that nothing, it's like people think that like fixing something means it's fixed.
zh: 我觉得最难的部分是,没有什么,就是人们以为修好一样东西就意味着它修好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like the person running customer service of a $10 million business is very different than the person who runs it of a 30 and of 100.
zh: 比如经营一千万美元业务的客服负责人,和经营三千万以及一亿美元业务的负责人,是非常不同的。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of that happened in 12 months.
zh: 而所有这些都发生在十二个月内。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so like you finally get customer service, like you get the person in there and it's like good and like the systems and you have like the location in Scottsdale now because it's more scalable and like whatever.
zh: 所以比如你终于把客服搞定了,比如你把人招进来了,一切都不错,系统也有了,你还因为更有扩展性而在 Scottsdale 设了办公地点之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you turn around to fix the next thing, and you already suddenly realize customer service is broken again.
zh: 然后你转身去修下一件事,却突然发现客服又崩了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because it's now doubled again, and there's no space, and the fire department came and told us that we couldn't have all these people here.
zh: 因为它又翻倍了,没空间了,消防部门来告诉我们不能让这么多人都待在这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is before remote work was easy.
zh: 那是在远程办公变容易之前。

speaker: Unknown
en: The problem was you didn't even get to fix things because you'd fix something, and then it would break again because you just were scaling so fast.
zh: 问题是你根本来不及修东西,因为你刚修好一样东西,它就又崩了,因为你扩张得太快了。

speaker: Unknown
en: That you're jumping through too many like gates too quickly.
zh: 以至于你跳过的门槛太多、太快。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like you're going company size wise, like the people that are able to do these things, very few of them can scale from zero to, and there are, but there's like Dave Savage who runs our procurement, the person who is doing the boxes.
zh: 比如从公司规模来说,能做这些事的人里,极少数能从零一路扩展,虽然确实有,比如负责我们采购的 Dave Savage,那个做箱子的人。

speaker: Unknown
en: Still with us today.
zh: 今天仍然和我们在一起。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like there are definitely people that are able to scale all the way through.
zh: 所以确实有些人能够一路扩展到底。

speaker: Unknown
en: I see a lot of them like did not have that same ability.
zh: 但我看到很多其他人并不具备同样的能力。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like they just like, you know, it just, it sort of escaped their capability at that time or whatever it was, but maybe it was us too.
zh: 比如他们就是,你知道,它就有点超出了他们当时的能力范围之类的,但也可能是我们的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like it's not, it's not indictment on them, but whatever, for whatever the reason, like they weren't able to like keep handle of that area finance.
zh: 就比如说，这并不是对他们的指责，但不管怎样，无论出于什么原因，他们就是没能掌控住那个领域——金融。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, like doing, you know, a person who's used to doing finance for a $20 million a year business, probably not the same person for a $100 million a year business that's growing fast.
zh: 我的意思是,比如,你知道,一个习惯于为年收入两千万美元的公司做财务的人,很可能不适合为一家快速增长、年收入一亿美元的公司做财务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Again, less than 12 months.
zh: 再说一次,这一切发生在不到十二个月里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I know you did some really good athlete, celebrity endorsements, partnerships.
zh: 我知道你们做过一些非常出色的运动员、名人代言和合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: That can also be a disaster sometimes.
zh: 这种事有时候也可能变成灾难。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think one you did that worked out really well was with Shaq.
zh: 所以我觉得你们做得非常成功的一次是和 Shaq(奥尼尔)的合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: So how did that come about?
zh: 那么这是怎么达成的?

speaker: Unknown
en: And then how did you work with him in a way that was very effective for the business?
zh: 还有你们是怎么和他合作的,以至于对业务非常有效?

speaker: Unknown
en: So Shaq, again, go back to authenticity, right?
zh: 那么 Shaq,再回到真实性,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Shaq was his celebrity, so that's good.

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was like, for us, that was really like a great thing.

speaker: Unknown
en: Now, that's crazy because there's no way we could have afforded it, but I started doing the exercise of it, and I asked an agent in LA, how do you hire celebrities to do commercials?
zh: 这想法很疯狂,因为我们根本付不起,但我开始做这个尝试,我问了洛杉矶的一个经纪人,怎么请名人拍广告?

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't get to pay them, but I didn't know who you talked to, it was like whatever.

en: And they said, that's what I do.

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm an agent.

speaker: Unknown
en: That's what I do.
zh: 这就是我的工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I was like, great.
zh: 所以我说,太好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm talking about what we're doing.
zh: 我就跟他们讲了我们在做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Ring was starting to get out there.
zh: 当时 Ring 开始有点名气了。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Shaq's people, they do these calls with agents, and they were talking about stuff.
zh: 奥尼尔的人,他们会和经纪人开这种电话会,他们在聊一些事情。

en: And Shaq said, I would like to get in touch with the Ring company.

en: I just bought their stuff from my house.

speaker: Unknown
en: They're better security.
zh: 他们的安防更好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the guy's like, this is insane.
zh: 那个人就说,这也太巧了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just talked to them.
zh: 我刚跟他们聊过。

speaker: Unknown
en: They want to do stuff.
zh: 他们想做些合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so they put us, so the guy calls me, the agent is like, Shaq would like to meet you.
zh: 于是他们把我们,那个人就打电话给我,那个经纪人说,奥尼尔想见你。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, oh, okay.
zh: 我说,哦,好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm happy to meet Shaq.
zh: 我很乐意见奥尼尔。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like a kid from New Jersey.
zh: 我就是个新泽西来的孩子。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, sure, I'm happy to meet Shaq.
zh: 我说,当然,我很乐意见奥尼尔。

en: And so we end up meeting at CES.
zh: 于是我们在 CES 上见面了。

en: He comes to our booth at CES, which was crazy.
zh: 他来到我们在 CES 的展位,太不可思议了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Was this a planned, scheduled meeting, or he just walked up?
zh: 这是提前计划好的、约好的会面,还是他直接走过来的?

speaker: Unknown
en: They scheduled it.
zh: 是约好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: They said he's going to come to your booth at whatever, like noon on Thursday.
zh: 他们说他会在周四中午左右到你们的展位。

speaker: Unknown
en: I didn't tell anyone because I'm like, there's no way Shaq's showing up.
zh: 我没告诉任何人,因为我想,奥尼尔不可能真来的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I'm like, I don't want to, if I tell the whole team that Shaq's showing up to our booth and he doesn't show up, I'm going to look like an idiot.
zh: 所以我想,我不想,如果我告诉整个团队奥尼尔要来我们展位结果他没来,我会看起来像个傻瓜。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I don't tell anyone.
zh: 所以我谁也没告诉。

speaker: Unknown
en: At the time, my head of comms, this girl, Yossi, is still with Amazon, and she was the biggest Lakers fan in the world.
zh: 当时我的传播主管,一个叫 Yossi 的女孩,现在还在 Amazon,她是全世界最狂热的湖人队球迷。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so all of a sudden, Shaq's walking down.
zh: 突然,奥尼尔走了过来。

speaker: Unknown
en: She goes, oh, my God, Shaq.
zh: 她说,天哪,是奥尼尔。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'm like, yeah, and he's coming here for a meeting.
zh: 我说,是啊,他是来和我们开会的。

speaker: Unknown
en: No way.
zh: 不可能吧。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm like, yeah.
zh: 我说,是真的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was fun.
zh: 那很有趣。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'll never forget her face.
zh: 我永远忘不了她当时的表情。

speaker: Unknown
en: But so Shaq came, we started talking.
zh: 然后奥尼尔来了,我们开始聊。

speaker: Unknown
en: I told him about like, we care about neighborhoods and neighborhood security, and this is what we're doing.
zh: 我跟他讲了我们关心社区和社区安全,以及我们在做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Shaq's like, I want to work with you.
zh: 奥尼尔说,我想和你们合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I'm like, oh, okay.
zh: 我说,哦,好的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's like, I want to work with you, you know, Mr. O'Neill, you know.
zh: 就是,我想和您合作,您知道,奥尼尔先生,您知道的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And as I said to him, well, I don't know how this like, do I, what do we pay?
zh: 然后我对他说,嗯,我不知道这,我该,我们怎么付钱?

speaker: Unknown
en: And he just like puts his fingers in his ears.
zh: 他直接把手指塞进耳朵里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this guy is like, I mean, he's, Shaq's very large.
zh: 而这个人,我是说,他,奥尼尔块头非常大。

speaker: Unknown
en: We're in this little tiny room that can barely fit Shaq and me because it's like in our booth.
zh: 我们在一个小得几乎装不下奥尼尔和我的小房间里,因为那是在我们展位里面。

speaker: Unknown
en: And he's just going, la, la, la, I do not talk about money.
zh: 他就一直说,啦啦啦,我不谈钱的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the person with him is like, yeah, well, you'll talk to me.
zh: 和他一起的人说,好吧,那你可以跟我谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: Shaq likes to only do things that he cares about.
zh: 奥尼尔只做他真正在意的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that's, I think, again, why is Shaq such a great brand in what he's done is because he stayed authentic.
zh: 所以我想,这也是为什么奥尼尔能成为这么棒的品牌,因为他始终保持真实。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so then we ended up working together.
zh: 于是我们最终开始合作了。

speaker: Unknown
en: He said he'll take his fee in equity.
zh: 他说他的报酬要以股权来支付。

speaker: Unknown
en: Which ended up being great for him, which is great because he was a huge benefit.
zh: 这对他来说最终非常划算，这很好，因为他带来了巨大的帮助。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Shaq became a great spokesperson with us, really helped us, again, part of building that authentic brand.
zh: 而且 Shaq 成为了我们很棒的代言人，真的帮了我们很多，再次，是打造那种真实品牌的一部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it did work.
zh: 所以这确实行得通。

speaker: Unknown
en: You like FaceTime him during board meetings, I think?
zh: 我记得你在董事会会议期间会跟他视频通话？

speaker: Unknown
en: Oh, we'd have, yeah, I mean, Shaq's a big FaceTimer, so he would, like, you'd FaceTime him or he'd FaceTime you.
zh: 哦，我们会有，是的，我是说，Shaq 很爱视频通话，所以他会，就是，你会跟他视频通话，或者他跟你视频通话。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was like, there's, yeah, I mean, I still talk to him a little bit, like, not as much, just because we were, when we were working together, obviously, you'd talk to someone a lot more.
zh: 就是那样，是的，我是说，我现在还稍微跟他有些联系，没那么多了，只是因为我们以前一起共事时，显然，你会跟一个人聊得多得多。

speaker: Unknown
en: And it'd be funny, because I'd be somewhere, and, you know, we were growing the business.
zh: 而且很好笑，因为我会身在某个地方，你知道，我们在发展业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wasn't, like, I wasn't that big of a thing.
zh: 我当时，我并不是什么大人物。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I'd be somewhere, and, like, Shaq would be FaceTiming.
zh: 而我会身在某个地方，然后，Shaq 就打来视频通话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Of course, I'd be like, oh, like, look who it is.
zh: 当然，我会说，哦，看看这是谁。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, it's like Shaq, you're like, holy shit.
zh: 你知道，就像 Shaq，你会觉得，天哪。

speaker: Unknown
en: Shaq's just FaceTiming this guy.
zh: Shaq 居然在跟这个人视频通话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Shaq's just FaceTiming, you know, he'd be, like, telling me stuff.
zh: Shaq 就在视频通话，你知道，他会，比如，跟我说些事情。

en: Did you end up doing a commercial with him?
zh: 你们最后有跟他拍广告吗？

en: Oh, many.
zh: 哦，很多。

en: Really?

en: Many.

en: Okay.

en: And even like my favorite one is I did when my son was probably eight or nine or something.

speaker: Unknown
en: And we did Shaq and Go Seek.
zh: 我们拍了「Shaq 捉迷藏」。

en: Yeah.

en: And so we had Oliver, like my son, basically like, you know, like on the phone being like, you know, with the camera and being like, Shaq, I see you.
zh: 于是我们让 Oliver，比如我儿子，基本上就是在电话上，你知道，对着摄像头说，你知道的，Shaq，我看到你了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: He was like, you know, like jumping up and jumping down.
zh: 他那时，你知道，蹦蹦跳跳地上蹿下跳。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it was like, it was like a really fun, that was, that was one of my favorites.
zh: 然后那就像，那是一个非常好玩的，那是，那是我最喜欢的之一。

speaker: Unknown
en: So that was cool.
zh: 所以那很酷。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是的。

en: Yeah.

speaker: Unknown
en: Well, and so you sold the company to Amazon.
zh: 好，那你把公司卖给了 Amazon。

speaker: Unknown
en: What was that like to, to selling?
zh: 出售是什么感觉？

speaker: Unknown
en: Cause you were continuing to just scale and you obviously like, again, you needed money, you realized you needed money.
zh: 因为你当时在继续扩张，显然，你知道，你需要钱，你意识到你需要钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: 300 million bucks.
zh: 3 亿美元。

speaker: Unknown
en: How did that conversation come about and happen?
zh: 那场对话是怎么产生、怎么发生的？

speaker: Unknown
en: It was definitely a crazy time for the business.
zh: 那对业务来说绝对是一段疯狂的时期。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'd say the one thing, and this is everything in life, is be long-term.
zh: 我想说的其中一点，而这也是人生中的一切，就是要着眼长期。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were working with Amazon.
zh: 我们当时在和 Amazon 合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've been talking to them for years.
zh: 我们跟他们谈了好几年。

speaker: Unknown
en: You're probably a big seller on the platform, I'm assuming.
zh: 你们大概是平台上很大的卖家，我猜。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were a seller, but also we were working with Alexa.
zh: 我们是卖家，但同时我们也在和 Alexa 合作。

speaker: Unknown
en: And for the right, good intentions.
zh: 而且是出于正确的、好的初衷。

speaker: Unknown
en: We weren't just talking to them to sell the company or to have a relationship.
zh: 我们不只是为了卖公司或者为了建立一段关系而跟他们谈。

speaker: Unknown
en: We weren't trying to have a relationship.
zh: 我们不是刻意想建立一段关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: We had a real relationship.
zh: 我们有一段真实的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: We were actually working with them and doing stuff.
zh: 我们当时真的在和他们合作、一起做事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I always think, get out there and create these real relationships.
zh: 而我一直认为，要走出去，去建立这些真实的关系。

speaker: Unknown
en: Don't just be transactional.
zh: 不要只是停留在交易层面。

speaker: Unknown
en: This is the missionary versus mercenary.
zh: 这就是传教士与雇佣兵的区别。

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, at some point, Amazon then was like, we should, you know, this is a part of like the home and what we're doing.
zh: 你知道,到了某个时候,当时的亚马逊就说,我们应该,你知道,这是家庭的一部分,也是我们在做的事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: And like, we see that Jamie, like with the mission of making it safer.
zh: 而且,我们看到Jamie,带着让这件事更安全的使命。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so they ended up finally saying like, yeah, let's, let's, you know, we want to do this.
zh: 所以他们最终说,好吧,我们想做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they came to me.
zh: 然后他们来找了我。

speaker: Unknown
en: And at that point, I was, I was definitely ready.
zh: 而那个时候,我 definitely 已经准备好了。

speaker: Unknown
en: I'd say I was ready to sell, just because I was just like, it was so I had.
zh: 我会说,我已经准备好卖了,因为我就是,实在太,我有。

speaker: Unknown
en: I was ready to sell a meeting.
zh: 我准备好卖掉一场会议。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wanted to be at the business.
zh: 我想待在这门生意里。

speaker: Unknown
en: I wasn't ready to sell to get rid of it, but I needed a partner to come in.
zh: 我不是准备好卖掉然后摆脱它,而是我需要一个合作伙伴进来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really needed someone to come in and help me because I actually did want to stay.
zh: 我真的需要有人进来帮我,因为我其实确实想留下来。

speaker: Unknown
en: I just couldn't take the like emotional ride and like it was just killing me so far.
zh: 我只是承受不了那种情绪上的过山车,那简直快把我折磨死了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it was like the point where and I knew Amazon if you look at like other founders at its little companies that Amazon that stayed like Audible and like, you know, like Zappos and Tony Hsieh.
zh: 所以到了那个地步,而且我了解亚马逊,如果你看看那些留在亚马逊旗下小公司的其他创始人,比如 Audible,再比如,你知道,像 Zappos 的 Tony Hsieh。

speaker: Unknown
en: And so I was like, you know, I'm going to like they'll let me sort of do what I want to do.
zh: 所以我就想,你知道,他们会让我差不多做自己想做的事。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, I feel like you were kind of, from what I know, you were kind of like nervous the whole way of like, this could just blow up at any time.
zh: 是啊,据我所知,你一路上都挺紧张的,总觉得这事随时可能崩盘。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, I don't want to lose people's money.
zh: 就像,我不想亏掉别人的钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: That was, yeah.
zh: 是的,就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, that was definitely a way it is.
zh: 我是说,那 definitely 是其中一种状态。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, it does weigh on you at some point, like the more money you get.
zh: 我是说,到了某个时候它确实压在你身上,钱越多越是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the risk was,
zh: 而风险是,

speaker: Unknown
en: Getting worse, not better, because the bigger we were getting, the smaller number of people that could bail us out.
zh: 越来越糟,而不是越来越好,因为我们规模越大,能救我们的人就越少。

speaker: Unknown
en: That year when we did the B round with Richard Branson, if things had changed then, if the growth had slowed, you would have been off by like...
zh: 那一年我们和 Richard Branson 做了 B 轮,如果当时情况有变,如果增长放缓,你可能就会差……

speaker: Unknown
en: Call it even like $10 million, which is like not like nothing, but like you can get Richard Branson to give you another 10 million if the business is good.
zh: 差不多差个一千万美元吧,这不是小数目,但只要生意好,你是可以让 Richard Branson 再给你一千万的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like I could have called Richard and said, listen, we're off by this, but like, here's what's going on.
zh: 就像我本可以打电话给 Richard 说,听着,我们差了这么多,但是,情况是这样的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, you know, can you help us?
zh: 你知道,你能帮帮我们吗?

speaker: Unknown
en: Like might have cost us a little bit of equity, but like you could have, like it was, I think there's a lot of people to make that phone call to, True Ventures probably, you know, like you could have like raised that money.
zh: 可能会损失一点股权,但是,你是可以打的,我觉得有很多可以打这种电话的人,True Ventures 大概可以,你知道,你差不多能募到那笔钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: When you're doing 480 million,
zh: 但当你做到四亿八千万的时候,

speaker: Unknown
en: And you're going to a billion.
zh: 然后要冲十亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: If you're off by a couple hundred million, Richard's like, I can't wire you a couple hundred million.
zh: 如果你差个几亿,Richard 就会说,我没法给你打几个亿。

speaker: Unknown
en: True Ventures is like, I can't.
zh: True Ventures 也会说,我做不到。

speaker: Unknown
en: In a weird way, the bigger it got, the riskier it got because there was just less people that could bail us out of these.
zh: 说来奇怪,规模越大,风险反而越大,因为能救我们的人就更少了。

speaker: Unknown
en: A small mistake became a much bigger blemish.
zh: 一个小错误会变成大得多的污点。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do you have any founders or CEOs or maybe like people from history that you've gotten a lot of inspiration from or that you've learned a lot from?
zh: 有没有什么创始人、CEO,或者历史上的什么人,是你从中获得了很多启发,或者学到了很多?

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, just like the company grew so fast and became a different business.
zh: 你知道,公司增长得那么快,变成了一门完全不同的生意。

speaker: Unknown
en: There was people at like different stages that I really like when I was...
zh: 在不同的阶段都有我真正喜欢的人,当我……

speaker: Unknown
en: When I was about to ship a product, this guy, Jim Hyman, helped me because he does safes in Los Angeles.
zh: 当我正要发布一款产品时,有个人叫 Jim Hyman,他帮了我,他在洛杉矶做保险箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: He makes safes.
zh: 他做保险箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Like locking safes to put your jewelry in or whatever under the Honeywell brand.
zh: 就是以 Honeywell 品牌做用来放珠宝之类东西的锁定保险箱。

speaker: Unknown
en: He helped me with how do you insure a product?
zh: 他帮了我怎么给产品投保,

speaker: Unknown
en: How do you get it here?
zh: 怎么把货运到这里,

en: How do you pay tariffs?
zh: 怎么交关税。

speaker: Unknown
en: I don't know how to do anything.
zh: 我什么都不懂。

speaker: Unknown
en: I really didn't know how to do anything.
zh: 我真的什么都不懂。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then all of a sudden, our business was doing more than Jim's was.
zh: 但突然之间,我们的生意做得比 Jim 的还大了。
